references.title: The Best Humidifiers | Lab Tested & Ranked
Levoit OasisMist 1000S Smart Tower Humidifier Review

en.commentary: I put the Levoit LV600S first and I stand behind it. It gives me warm and cool mist in one 6L body, covers up to 753 sq ft, runs about 50 hours on low and costs around $110. That mix of output, app control and price beats everything else I can name for a bedroom or living room. The Honeywell HCM350B takes second because its UV light and wicking filter deliver clean moisture with zero white dust on the furniture, which makes it my pick for a baby room. The OasisMist 1000S gets my nod for large rooms, with a 10L tank that lasts up to 100 hours. The Classic 300S at about $72 is the value anchor, and its top-fill tank turns weekly cleaning into a two-minute job. The Dreo HM524S at 28 dB on low is a superb sleeper, though I would trust a separate hygrometer over its built-in reading. For a whole home, the AIRCARE MA1201 covers up to 3,600 sq ft and the Vornado Evap40 handles 1,000 sq ft with a five-year warranty. Pick by room size first, then by how much cleaning you will realistically do.

highlights.title: Levoit LV600S is the best all-round humidifier
highlights.body: One 6L tank gives warm mist for cold nights and cool mist for summer, and coverage reaches 753 sq ft. Around 50 hours on low means one refill lasts a work week, and the app lets me hold a target humidity without walking over to the unit.

highlights.title: Honeywell HCM350B is the baby room choice
highlights.body: The evaporative wick lets water evaporate into the room, so mineral dust stays in the filter. A UV lamp treats up to 99.9% of bacteria in the tank water. Cool mist keeps the surface free of hot water, which suits a nursery.

highlights.title: OasisMist 1000S is the large room answer
highlights.body: Its 10L tank lasts up to 100 hours and serves rooms of 300 to 600 sq ft. At about $150 it costs more than the LV600S, and it earns that price in living rooms and open-plan studios where a 6L unit runs dry too fast.

highlights.title: Classic 300S makes cleaning easy
highlights.body: The top-fill design lets me pour water straight in and lift out the tank for a quick rinse. Around $72 for 60 hours of runtime and app control makes it the humidifier I recommend to first-time buyers.

highlights.title: AIRCARE MA1201 and Vornado Evap40 cover the whole home
highlights.body: The MA1201 handles up to 3,600 sq ft with a 3.6-gallon tank and casters. The Evap40 covers 1,000 sq ft with a dual tank, a built-in humidistat and a five-year warranty. Both use wick filters, so plan on replacing them each season.

zh-tw.commentary: 我把 Levoit LV600S 放第一名，而且很有把握。它一台就有暖霧和冷霧，6 公升水箱，適用到 753 平方英尺，低速可以撐約 50 小時，價格大約 $110，折合台幣三千多。加濕量、App 控制和價格湊在一起，臥室或客廳我想不到更好的選擇。Honeywell HCM350B 排第二，UV 燈加濕膜濾網讓出來的濕氣很乾淨，家具上不會有白粉，我會推給有嬰兒房的人。OasisMist 1000S 是大坪數首選，10 公升水箱最長可撐約 100 小時。Classic 300S 大約 $72，是我心中的 CP 值代表，上注水設計讓每週清洗變成兩分鐘的小事。Dreo HM524S 低速只有 28 分貝，睡覺時很安靜，不過它內建的濕度讀數我會搭配另一支濕度計一起看。全屋需求的話，AIRCARE MA1201 可以涵蓋到 3,600 平方英尺，Vornado Evap40 涵蓋 1,000 平方英尺還有 5 年保固。先看房間大小，再看自己願意花多少力氣清潔，這樣選就對了。

highlights.title: Levoit LV600S 是最均衡的全能選手
highlights.body: 一顆 6 公升水箱同時提供暖霧和冷霧，冬天夜裡用暖霧，夏天開冷霧，涵蓋範圍到 753 平方英尺。低速約 50 小時，一次加水可以用滿一整週，App 還能設定目標濕度，人不用走到機器旁邊。

highlights.title: Honeywell HCM350B 是嬰兒房的首選
highlights.body: 蒸發式濕膜讓水自然蒸發進空氣，礦物質全部留在濾網裡，UV 燈處理水箱內高達 99.9% 的細菌。冷霧的出口沒有熱水，擺在寶寶房間我比較放心。

highlights.title: OasisMist 1000S 是大房間的答案
highlights.body: 10 公升水箱最長約 100 小時，適用 300 至 600 平方英尺。大約 $150 比 LV600S 貴，但客廳或開放式小套房用 6 公升機型很快就見底，這筆差價花得值得。

highlights.title: Classic 300S 讓清洗變得輕鬆
highlights.body: 上注水設計讓我直接倒水，水箱拿起來沖一下就好。大約 $72 就有 60 小時運轉和 App 控制，我會把它推薦給第一次買加濕器的朋友。

highlights.title: AIRCARE MA1201 與 Vornado Evap40 適合全屋
highlights.body: MA1201 有 3.6 加侖水箱和滾輪，涵蓋最大 3,600 平方英尺。Evap40 是雙水箱設計，涵蓋 1,000 平方英尺，內建濕度控制，還有 5 年保固。兩台都是濕膜濾網，每季記得更換。
